resources.string: The PIN cannot be recovered: it is stored only on this device. You can erase all app data and start over.
Unlock with your fingerprint or face and change the PIN in settings. If that is not possible, you can erase all app data and start over.
Cycles, logs, medications, favourites and settings will be deleted for good. The app will close and start with the welcome screen next time.
Too many attempts. Try again in %1$d:%2$02d
The PINs did not match, try again
Ask for it when opening the app
Unavailable: no strong biometrics on this device, none set up, or Android older than 10
Shows a blank preview. Screenshots inside the app are blocked too. On Android 13 and later the preview is hidden anyway while a PIN is set
PIN is set. You can change or remove it in settings.
Fingerprints or faces on the phone changed. Turn biometric unlock on again
Could not turn on: the phone needs a screen lock and strong biometrics
The system did not allow erasing the data. Clear it in Android settings: Apps → Twilight Cycle → Storage → Clear data
Could not save the PIN on this device. Please try again
